mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises above 2% annualized and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods following such declines.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp, and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rises by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
